name: button
title: Button
blurb: Unstyled button with six semantic variants and flexible sizing.
description: A versatile button component using CVA (class-variance-authority) for variant and size control. Supports six variants (default, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive, link) and four sizes (sm, default, lg, icon).
use_when: Any button context where you need semantic styling and flexibility.
avoid_when: When you need highly customized animations or effects.
a11y: Full keyboard navigation and focus-visible ring. Supports disabled state.
